title: OmniSight tier-paths.yaml
description: Schema for configs/governance/tier-paths.yaml (ADR-0005). Constrains the path-glob -> AI-authority-tier mapping consumed by the G2 classifier and G3 Gerrit hook.

schema_version.description: Bump only on incompatible structural change. Loader pinned to 1.

s.description: Tier S — Safe. AI may self-+2 when EVERY touched path matches one of these globs.

m.description: Tier M — Medium. Implicit fallback for un-classified production code; carries no globs.

l.description: Tier L — Large. AI +1 advisory + Human +2 mandatory. Triggered when ANY touched path matches.

x.description: Tier X — Extreme. Human +2 + architectural reviewer +1. Triggered when ANY touched path matches.

glob.description: Repo-relative POSIX-style glob (forward slashes, fnmatch-extended with ** for recursive). Must be non-empty and must not start with a slash.
